summary: Executed full end-to-end Playwright flow for MPCA Unified Budget → Finance Console linking + Budget Freeze workflow on tournament 8cf98196 (MY Memorial Trophy). 24 of 25 assertions PASSED. Login as Secretary persona, panel opens with 4 hero tiles (grand=₹15,23,860, md, nmd, avg), 4 owner rollup pills (Host/Visitor/Officials/Common), all 5 tabs (head/pool/body/match/travel) present. By Body table renders with 4 division rows: DIV-BPL=₹15,23,860 (host), DIV-GWL=₹95,900, DIV-JBP=₹81,900, DIV-RWA=₹81,900 (visiting travel grants). Lock flow works: banner shows 'Budget locked at v5', ub-save-snapshot becomes disabled with title='Unlock first', lock↔unlock button swap correct. Unlock flow correctly reverses state. Lock state PERSISTS across hard reload (banner + unlock button restored from Tournament.unified_budget_snapshot.is_locked backend field). Cross-tab consistency verified — grand total stays exactly ₹15,23,860 on all 5 tabs (compute called once, no drift). Travel tab label = 'TRAVEL GRANT · ₹2,59,700'. Cleanup unlock at end succeeded.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast element not observable at assertion time — either auto-dismisses too fast (<toast lifetime shorter than post-lock settle) or is rendered elsewhere. Banner text 'Budget locked at v5' confirms the lock succeeded, but the 'Locked at v{N}' toast requirement was not visually verifiable in the DOM after wait_for_timeout(2000). Consider extending toast visibility to ≥3s or using a persistent state marker.

critical_code_review_comments: React console warning during render: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of UnifiedBudgetPanel.' — one of the .map() calls in UnifiedBudgetPanel.jsx is missing a key prop. Non-blocking but should be fixed for React reconciliation performance / correctness.

rca of the issue: ub-saved toast miss — most likely cause is toast auto-dismiss timer shorter than the 2s post-click wait; the banner (persistent) already proves lock succeeded so this is a testability gap, not a functional bug.
